summary: This document is a residential tenancy agreement between Mr. Tariq Mehmood and Mrs. Sana Raza for a property in Bahadurabad, Karachi, lasting for three years. By signing this, the tenant agrees to pay a monthly rent of Rs. 125,000, provide a two-month security deposit, and vacate the premises by 14 August 2029. You should pay close attention to the clauses regarding the annual rent increase and the landlord's power to re-enter the property, as these terms may conflict with standard local rental regulations. These specific sections could potentially lead to disputes regarding your rights to a fair rent increment and the legal process required for eviction.

flagged_clauses.text:
1. Parties and premises. The Landlord lets the premises at
Bahadurabad, Karachi to the Tenant for residential use only.
flagged_clauses.note: Section 5 of the Sind Rented Premises Ordinance, 1979 requires that the rental agreement be in writing and attested by the Controller, a Civil Judge, or a First-Class Magistrate.

flagged_clauses.text:
2. Rent. The Tenant shall pay monthly rent of Rs. 125,000 in
advance before the fifth day of each month. The rent shall stand
enhanced by fifteen per centum (15%) per annum on each renewal.
flagged_clauses.note: The 15% annual rent increase exceeds the 10% maximum annual increase permitted under Section 9(2) of the Sind Rented Premises Ordinance, 1979.

flagged_clauses.text:
3. Security deposit. The Tenant shall deposit two months rent as
security, refundable on vacation less lawful deductions.
flagged_clauses.note: The provision for a security deposit is not explicitly prohibited under the provided sections of the Sind Rented Premises Ordinance, 1979.

flagged_clauses.text:
4. Forfeiture and re-entry. On any default beyond seven days, the
Landlord shall, without notice or recourse to any court, be
entitled to re-enter the premises and take possession thereof.
flagged_clauses.note: A landlord cannot unilaterally re-enter or take possession without an order from the Controller, as eviction must be processed according to Section 15 of the Sind Rented Premises Ordinance, 1979.

flagged_clauses.text:
5. Term. This lease is for three years and the Tenant shall vacate
on or before 14 August 2029.
flagged_clauses.note: The specified term and vacate date are consistent with standard contractual practice, provided the agreement is properly documented under Section 5 of the Sind Rented Premises Ordinance, 1979.

obligations.description: The tenant must pay the monthly rent.
The tenant must vacate the premises.
